name: Breakup Contract
description: A two-party stake-backed pact: both partners lock matching GAS, honor the term to reclaim each stake, or break early and credit both stakes to the other partner.
description_zh: 双人质押约定：双方锁定等额 GAS，履约到期可各自取回质押；提前违约则两份质押记入另一方的可提取额度。
